title: libmochiberry OTA manifest
description: Contract between the OTA build (scripts/make-ota.sh) and the device updater. A device may swap any file listed here without re-coding the loader.

version.description: Bundle version, also the output directory name.

abi.description: Bytecode ABI tag. Devices must refuse bundles whose ABI differs from the loader's.

upgrade.description: How the device should apply this bundle.

no_recode.description: Upgrades never require re-coding; files are swapped as-is.

rollback.description: Identifier of the bundle to roll back to on failure.

role.description: engine: replaces libmochiberry.so; app-bytecode: the JS app; patch: pure-JS feature patch applied at boot.
